Question Choices: Select. A statistician made a dot plot, a histogram, and a box plot for the same data. Which of these choices marks the median directly?: ~~Histogram | Box-plot | Bar-graph~~
Hints: Check which exact values, summary positions, or interval counts the display retains.
Solution: A box plot marks the median with a line inside the box. A histogram groups observations; it generally cannot give the exact median. A dot plot can also be used to compute the median by ordering its observations.

Question Choices: Select. Can a dot plot be used to find the median?: ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: Check which exact values, summary positions, or interval counts the display retains.
Solution: A dot plot shows each exact data value. That means you can list the numbers in order and find the middle value, so a dot plot can be used to find the median.

Question Choices: Select. Which display is best for finding how many data values are greater than 200?: ~~Histogram | Box-plot | Pie-chart~~
Hints: Which graph lets you count how many values are in certain intervals?
Solution: A histogram shows how many data values are in each interval. So if you want to know how many values are greater than 200, you can count the bars for intervals above 200.

Question Choices: Select TRUE or FALSE of the statement. "A histogram always shows the exact value of every data point." ~~TRUE | FALSE~~
Hints: Check which exact values, summary positions, or interval counts the display retains.
Solution: A histogram groups data into intervals such as 80-85 or 200-250. It does not show every exact value.

Question Choices: Why does a box plot alone generally not determine the exact number of vehicles above 200,000 km?  (A) Because a box plot only shows the maximum value   (B) Because a box plot groups data into intervals   (C) Because a box plot shows quartiles and spread, not exact counts   (D) Because a box plot cannot show any data values
Hints: Check which exact values, summary positions, or interval counts the display retains.
Solution: C. A box plot shows a five-number summary and any marked outliers, not all interval frequencies or the sample size. These summaries generally do not determine an exact count above a specified cutoff.

Question Choices: Choose from histogram, pie chart, box plot, dot plot. Which display (1) marks the median directly with a line inside a box: ___; (2) uses bars to show frequencies for intervals: ___?
Hints: Check which exact values, summary positions, or interval counts the display retains.
